meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 在每次修改文件后自动检查代码注释;若发现可疑评论,会收到阻塞警告,需先修复或解释后才能继续。
howto.when: 在成功完成 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后触发。

say.text: 请修复刚才改动中被标记的问题评论。
say.note: 让 Claude 处理 checker 的警告。

say.text: 解释一下这个评论检查警告。
say.note: 让 Claude 说明警告原因。

howto.what_en: After each file modification, automatically checks code comments; if a suspicious comment is found, a blocking warning is received and must be fixed or explained before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers after successful edit-like operations such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc.

say_en.text: Please fix the flagged comment issue from the last change.
say_en.note: Instructs Claude to handle the checker warning.
Asks Claude to clarify the warning.
